title: Ignition Core Training
description: Concepts introduced while teaching Ignition Core.

placement_hint_fallback.reason: Ignition includes this course concept. Add a more specific connection when its related topic appears.

placement_hints.reason: Ignition is an industrial application platform.
The Gateway is Ignition's central server service.
The Designer connects to the Gateway to edit projects and tags.
The Designer Launcher starts a Designer session.
Projects are saved on the Gateway.
The Gateway connects to industrial devices.
Device connections are configured at the Gateway.
The Gateway manages device connections and tags.
The Gateway uses OPC UA for industrial data connections.
Tag providers organize tags on the Gateway.

alternates.reason: Tags are managed by the Gateway.

placement_hints.reason: A tag belongs to a tag provider.
Tag Groups control how often tags execute.

alternates.reason: UDTs are defined with the Gateway's tags.

placement_hints.reason: A UDT is a reusable tag type in a tag provider.

alternates.reason: UDT definitions are managed with Gateway tags.

placement_hints.reason: A tag provider contains reusable UDT definitions.

alternates.reason: A tag provider contains UDT instances.

placement_hints.reason: A UDT definition is used to create instances.
Perspective is a visualization module installed in the Gateway.
This topic introduces the core Perspective resources.
A Perspective project runs in browser or mobile sessions.
Views are the primary visual resources in Perspective.

alternates.reason: Perspective uses components to build views.

placement_hints.reason: A Perspective view contains components.

alternates.reason: Perspective supports property bindings.

placement_hints.reason: A component uses bindings to connect properties to data.

alternates.reason: Perspective supports transforms on bindings.

placement_hints.reason: A binding can apply transforms to its result.
Perspective uses styles to control the appearance of views and components.
Perspective uses style classes to share visual styles.

alternates.reason: Perspective uses Flex Containers for layout.

placement_hints.reason: A view can contain a Flex Container for responsive layout.

alternates.reason: Perspective supports reusing views inside other views.

placement_hints.reason: A view can embed another view.
Perspective provides Flex Repeater to show repeated views.
Pages are the main navigation units of Perspective sessions.

alternates.reason: Perspective supports docking views at page edges.

placement_hints.reason: A Perspective page can display docked views.

alternates.reason: Perspective supports navigation between pages.

placement_hints.reason: Pages provide destinations for Perspective navigation.
Identity providers are configured on the Gateway for authentication.
Gateway settings configure authentication and access controls.
Perspective uses security levels to control access.
Perspective can use security zones for access rules.

alternates.reason: The Gateway manages alarms.

placement_hints.reason: Alarms are commonly defined on tags.
The Gateway configures alarm journal storage.

alternates.reason: The Gateway runs alarm notification pipelines.

placement_hints.reason: Alarm notification pipelines are project resources.
The Gateway sends configured alarm notifications.
The Gateway manages historian configuration and tag history collection.

alternates.reason: Historian Core manages tag history.
The Gateway manages tag history collection.

placement_hints.reason: Tag history records values from tags.
The Gateway hosts the Historian Core module, which manages tag history.

alternates.reason: History providers are configured on the Gateway.

placement_hints.reason: Historian Core supports configurable history providers.

alternates.reason: The Gateway configures the Core Historian provider.

placement_hints.reason: Historian Core includes the embedded Core Historian storage provider.

alternates.reason: The Gateway hosts the SQL Historian module.

placement_hints.reason: The SQL Historian module extends Historian Core.

alternates.reason: Historian Core supports the SQL Historian provider when its module is installed.
The SQL Historian provider is configured on the Gateway.

placement_hints.reason: The SQL Historian module adds the SQL-backed history provider.
Database connections are managed at the Gateway.

alternates.reason: The Gateway executes configured Transaction Groups.

placement_hints.reason: Transaction Groups are project resources that exchange tag and database data.
The Gateway hosts the Reporting module.

alternates.reason: The Reporting module supports project reports.

placement_hints.reason: Reports are resources within an Ignition project.

alternates.reason: The Reporting module supports scheduled reports.

placement_hints.reason: A report can have a schedule for automatic delivery.
Vision is a visualization module installed in the Gateway.
Vision projects run in desktop clients.
Vision uses windows to build client screens.
Vision uses templates to reuse interface designs.
The Gateway supports system and project backups.
A Gateway backup captures Gateway configuration and projects.

alternates.reason: The Gateway supports export of individual projects.

placement_hints.reason: A project backup exports project-scoped resources.

alternates.reason: The Gateway supports exporting tags.

placement_hints.reason: Tags can be exported from a tag provider.
